scope: Fifteen exact base-text tedy/teda sites functioning as equivalence, definition, or appositional explication.
choice: Replace only the fifteen line-bound tokens with branch-neutral to jest.
motivation: The sites restate equivalent formulas, definitions, indices, split algebras, rings, ideals, or orders; none is temporal or inferential.
alternatives_rejected: Zato would turn definitions into conclusions.
Blanket family replacement would pre-empt the semantic classification of 236 remaining base tokens.

evidence.semantic_review: All fifteen sites were reviewed against mathematical context and German; every target line contains exactly one family token.

validation.postcondition: 15 sites zero; 236 base tokens deliberately untouched
validation.structure: TeX controls, labels/refs/cites, braces, math delimiters and line counts invariant
validation.reproducibility: frozen successor hashes reproduced before atomic apply
